title: Fold-only proof cites the wrong prev tick-1 hash (ab1fb0d04a90026c, not the pre-5.11 6c24e9cec592aece)
evidence:
- **Fold-only proof (boot):** the tick-1 state dump under the final code, with the previous hash spliced at the fold position (bytes 33..40), FNV-hashes to the previous golden tick-1 **exactly** (`ab1fb0d04a90026c`); the un-spliced dump hashes to the blessed tick-1 (`d1d2e53b7b1037ce`).
git show aec3c88:goldens/boot.t1 → `catalog_hash 66c4324a06058860` / `1 6c24e9cec592aece`
./bin/harness fold-check 66c4324a06058860 ab1fb0d04a90026c → `fold-check: spliced prev      6c24e9cec592aece  (must equal the prev tick-1)` then `fold-check: FAIL`
detail: `ab1fb0d04a90026c` is the intermediate 5.11-data tick-1 (commit 11c6cf6, catalog_hash 250679b1940fb87b), not pre-5.11 (66c4324a06058860 → 6c24e9cec592aece). Running the documented fold-check command FAILS, contradicting the proof.
recommended_fix: Correct the cited prev tick-1 to `6c24e9cec592aece` (the aec3c88 pre-5.11 tick-1 paired with the spliced 66c4324a06058860).

title: Campus-half landing floor hardcodes 10 instead of deriving it like EXPECTED (N3 vs N5 asymmetry)
evidence:
EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
	"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)
detail: N5 derives EXPECTED from the catalog so a re-tune cannot silently drift the pin, but the campus-half floor uses a literal 10 (campus vol 1 × multiplier 10). A campus-volume or multiplier re-tune would silently leave this floor stale.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus-half floor from the campus entry volume × surge.multiplier × WINDOW, mirroring the stream_entries loop.

title: fold-check documents a 'cross-checked against the blessed manifest' step that the code never performs
evidence:
// under the CURRENT catalogs, FNV's it (the NEW tick-1 — cross-checked against
fmt.printfln("fold-check: new tick-1        %016x  (the blessed manifest must match)", new_tick1)
detail: new_tick1 is only printed with a human-read hint; the sole assertion is `spliced_hash == prev_tick1_u`. A blessed manifest whose tick-1 diverges from the re-derived dump would still pass.
recommended_fix: Either compare new_tick1 against a passed-in blessed tick-1 arg (or the goldens/boot.t1 manifest) and fail on mismatch, or soften the comment to 'printed for the reviewer'.

title: usage() help string omits the new fold-check subcommand
evidence: fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png]")
detail: The runtime usage text (printed on any arg error / no-args) does not list `fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>`, though the header comment and the dispatch branch both add it.
recommended_fix: Append `| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` to the usage() string.
